LanguageData.Raven_IndustrialSupportColumn.label: (Raven) Industrial Support Column
LanguageData.Raven_IndustrialSupportColumn.descriptio: A high-strength load-bearing column used in Raven industrial facilities. Its support radius is the same as the Raven grand column, and it does not block sight or pawn movement.
LanguageData.Raven_Decoration_Stairs.label: (Raven) Stairs
LanguageData.Raven_Decoration_Stairs.description: Decorative Raven-style stairs. The texture changes with rotation for three directions, and it does not impede pawn movement.
